title.en: Explain how planning and controlling depend on each other
Explain why both are backward and forward looking

say.en: Planning without controlling is meaningless; controlling without planning is blind. Today we see why. In this lesson: Explain how planning and controlling depend on each other.
Explain why both are backward and forward looking.

body.en: *Planning* sets the objectives and standards; controlling checks whether they are achieved. Without plans there is nothing to compare performance with, so control is blind. Without control there is no way to know whether plans are working, so planning is meaningless. Planning is prescriptive (it lays down what to do); controlling is evaluative (it checks what was done).
body.kn: ಯೋಜನೆ ಗುರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾನದಂಡ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಅವು ಸಾಧನೆಯಾಗಿವೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಯೋಜನೆ ನಿರ್ದೇಶಾತ್ಮಕ, ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನಾತ್ಮಕ.

body.en: It is often said planning looks ahead and controlling looks back. In fact planning also looks back, since plans are based on past experience, and controlling also looks ahead, since it improves future performance. So both are forward *looking* and backward looking.

say.en: Controlling guides future action.

problem.en: A company planned sales of ₹50 lakh but achieved ₹40 lakh. It finds that the target ignored a new competitor, and next year plans ₹45 lakh with a bigger advertising budget. Show the link between planning and controlling.

steps.en: The plan (₹50 lakh) gave the standard; without it the ₹40 lakh could not be judged.
Controlling found a shortfall of ₹10 lakh, i.e. 20%, and its cause.
This finding was used to make a more realistic plan for next year.

answer.en: Planning provides the standard for control, and control provides the feedback for better planning.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. A company planned sales of ₹50 lakh but achieved ₹40 lakh. It finds that the target ignored a new competitor, and next year plans ₹45 lakh with a bigger advertising budget. Show the link between planning and controlling.

say.en: Let us work through this case together. A company planned sales of 50 rupees lakh but achieved 40 rupees lakh. It finds that the target ignored a new competitor, and next year plans 45 rupees lakh with a bigger advertising budget. Show the link between planning and controlling.
The plan 50 rupees lakh gave the standard; without it the 40 rupees lakh could not be judged.
Controlling found a shortfall of 10 rupees lakh, i.e. 20 percent, and its cause.
This finding was used to make a more realistic plan for next year.
So the answer is Planning provides the standard for control, and control provides the feedback for better planning.
